scope: All existing continents and islands; candidate atlas is distinct from adopted natural features.
completionPercentReason: No weighted adoption denominator; candidate coverage, implementation stages and physical certainty are different measures. Flags may overlap and are not summed.

remainingCurrentLocalReview.step: Consolidate adoptable geometric diagnostics and physical holds into a final decision register and expose it through the unified atlas.
remainingCurrentLocalReview.stopCondition: Current nine-pond review closes when source/assumption/unknown decisions and links are consistent; no new basins or unbounded physical modelling are required.

separateOptionalWork: Resolve high-temperature PET and western desert setting choices with explicitly supported assumptions.
Adopt actual forest/wetland boundaries or individual volcano/lake features only with sufficient evidence or explicit worldbuilding choices.
Increase terrain/climate resolution as a separate scope; 6.5km interpolation is not new physical detail.
